All stages at a glance

On target: the output is within 10% of its target. R²: how much of an output the machine data can predict (0 means no better than guessing the average). Matters: how much of the prediction a machine's columns carry. We only use 6 outputs (3 per stage). The data is one run of a real line, and it has no product counts or stop times.
